ShaderNodePreset.Description: Chubby Sobel — 5x5 edge detection with softness, threshold, gain, colour mode and source compositing.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: Chobel

Uniform.Tooltip: Sample spacing in pixels. Increase to spread the kernel and fatten edges.
Uniform.Name: step_size

Uniform.Tooltip: Diffuses the edge response. Blends each kernel tap toward the local neighbourhood mean — higher values produce softer, more spread-out edges.
Uniform.Name: softness

Uniform.Tooltip: Clip edges below this value. Raise to suppress faint or noisy edges.
Uniform.Name: threshold

Uniform.Tooltip: Off = Luminance (BT.709), On = Per-Channel colour (detects isoluminant colour transitions)
Uniform.Name: color_edges

Uniform.Tooltip: Off = Edge matte only, On = Edge added over source
Uniform.Name: output_mode
